pca_implementation.imports: numba.njit and numpy.linalg.eigh/inv; no JAX import
pca_implementation.baseline_covariance: Unbiased covariance using multiplier 1/(n-1); robust covariance subsequently weights observations and divides by total weight.
pca_implementation.eigensystem: NumPy symmetric eigh; descending eigenvalue order; optional right-handed basis by flipping third eigenvector.
pca_implementation.normalized_eigenvalues: norm=True divides each eigenvalue by their sum.
pca_implementation.return_type: NumPy ndarray eigenvalues and eigenvectors, not JAX ArrayImpl objects.
